records.conditions: Existing continuous Flight 14 return acceptance rate, now also an explicit abort bound during a committed orbital burn. Exceeding this or the pointing bound blocks the burn; it does not automatically relight.
records.uncertainty: Controller safety/settling policy, not a hardware limit or an observed flown control history. Historical altitude, engine restart metadata and mission rate acceptance limits are unchanged.

records.source: Finite-startup pointing reserve inside the pre-existing 5 degree orbital burn bound; moving-Solar-System diagnostic exposed a startup committed nearly at 5 degrees that crossed the burn bound. Exosphere engineering control policy, not SpaceX telemetry.
records.conditions: Require at most 2 degrees pointing error before committing ignition, leaving 3 degrees reserve for finite startup and gimbal response. The ongoing pointing bound stays 5 degrees and the ignition rate bound stays 0.03 rad/s.
records.uncertainty: Estimated settling margin; not a measured hardware limit or a reconstruction of flown software. Mission rate and historical/landing acceptance limits remain unchanged.
